comments.value:
Hope I’m not violating any rules by bumping this, but we NEED this feature.  Holoport teleport is a real headache to use, and I can’t believe VRChat doesn’t have an easy, instant teleport like most VR apps have.

PLEASE implement this!!!

details:
A large accessibility issue for users who get VR Sickness, especially those new to VR, is the lack of a Teleportation Locomotion option. Most VR games already have teleportation by default, yet VRChat does not have it, and defaults to smooth locomotion. The only other option for a long time was Holoport, which is awkward to control and seems to be widely unfavorable. While steps towards more locomotion options have been made with the Smooth Locomotion Vignette system, Proper Teleportation Locomotion should also be considered.
Obviously, there will be some design challenges that would need to be overcome in order to properly implement Teleportation Locomotion. First would be in the design of Teleportation preventing users from clipping through objects. However, parts of the core functionality of Holoport's mechanics could be utilized to prevent such clipping, by making sure the user could reach the area the same as a user using Smooth Locomotion. Secondly, there's the concern that Teleportation Locomotion would break certain functionality in/exploit worlds. Like Holoport, it could use similar functionality to move the player a distance over time, but would just have a visual indicator rather than the user's avatar. However, this may still feel awkward to control. Another option would be to allow for world creators to allow or block the use of teleportation locomotion in their world. Even though this would limit some users from being able to experience some worlds if they cannot use smooth locomotion at all, the number of users benefitting from being able to now play VRChat comfortably would be a more favorable outcome.
title: Teleport Locomotion Option
